notes_for_editor: Thin record: two sources. The Forest Lookouts Livingston page is a title block only (Polk County, Texas Forest Service), with no build, staffing or site detail. The brief gives Forest Lookouts coordinates of 30.6943, -94.9376, which do not appear in the page text we read, so they are not used; the index coordinates are used nowhere in the story. The page does not say whether it covers Loc 1 or Loc 2. Two WebSearch calls found no Livingston-specific history; the search leads (Polk County Enterprise newspaper archive, Edward Cavallerano's Fire in the Piney Woods, Polk County Memorial Museum) were not read. The story is short because the sources say no more; it was not padded.
